name: Moyai
tagline: Self-hosted cloud coding agent via Slack/browser — PR + tests through LiteLLM

xSignals.text: LiteLLM open-sourced Moyai, the cloud coding agent its own team runs. You bring a Modal account and a LiteLLM gateway, then pick the agent, like Codex, Claude Code or OpenCode. Its 79% savings figure is LiteLLM's internal estimate, not a matched benchmark. News, not a test.

LiteLLM just open-sourced its escape from a $101,872 Devin bill. Moyai — a self-hosted cloud coding agent tasked from Slack — cost ~$21,700 for the same 31 days. ~79% less. The managed-agent markup is the real AI tax. Build or buy — what is your call?
